internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Sabine Independent School District is located in an unincorporated area on the western edge of Gregg County, Texas. The district is comprised of fourcampuses (elementary, intermediate, middle school and high school) that serve approximately 1500 students. Additional services for students are provided through the district's association with the Gregg County Special Education Shared Services Arrangement.
